decisions.title: Why TodoWrite Makes Plans Visible
decisions.description: TodoWrite asks the agent to turn an intention into a short, inspectable task list. That list gives the user a clear view of progress and gives the agent a stable structure for ordering work, tracking completion, and avoiding drift.
decisions.alternatives: The agent could keep a plan only in conversation text, but structured todos are easier to render, update, test, and inspect.

zh.title: 为什么 TodoWrite 能让计划可见
zh.description: TodoWrite 要求 Agent 把目标拆成简短、可检查的任务列表。用户可以直接看到进度，Agent 也能用这个结构安排顺序、跟踪完成情况，并减少跑偏。
zh.alternatives: Agent 也可以只在对话文本里描述计划，但结构化待办更容易展示、更新、测试和检查。

decisions.title: Why Reminders Help Completion
decisions.description: When open todos remain, a lightweight reminder can be injected into the conversation. This keeps the current plan visible while the agent works through tool calls and subtasks.
decisions.alternatives: Relying on model memory alone is fragile as context grows. A small explicit reminder is simple and predictable.

zh.title: 为什么提醒有助于完成任务
zh.description: 当仍有未完成待办时，系统可以向对话注入轻量提醒。这样 Agent 在执行工具和子任务时，仍能看到当前计划。
zh.alternatives: 只依赖模型记忆在上下文变长后并不可靠；显式的小提醒更简单、更可预测。
